text:
Maria: quick flag 
Rolled mixed fp8 path to 3% of /v1/translate-zh traffic this morning. Transl_quality (composite) slid from 0.913 -> 0.898 on our live holdout. No infra exceptions.

Lee: ouch. before we rip it back want to categorize cause: profile mismatch, tokenizer drift, or runtime kv-eviction-induced artifacts?

Sam: can we get per-profile breakdown? might be a single bad profile misapplied to a customer slot.

Maria: per-profile: profile-zh-2026-03b is the primary offender, shows higher repetition and occasional tokenization alignment issues.

Nora: proposal: add a "safety_score" for each profile = weighted(sum( degscore_norm, 1 - latency_regression, token_align_score )). threshold < 0.85 => auto-soft-fallback.

Devon: operations needs to see behavioral rollout knobs. suggested config:
```
quant_profile_safety:
  eval_interval_minutes: 360
  safety_weights:
    degscore: 0.6
    latency: 0.25
    token_align: 0.15
  safety_threshold: 0.85
  soft_fallback_pct: 90  # percent of traffic sent to fallback when triggered
  retain_probe_pct: 10   # small fraction still uses profile for diagnostics
  min_hits_before_eval: 500
```

Anya (QA): we can automate a short live-playback that runs the last 10k requests against fallback and profile and produce a diff heatmap. will add an automated job that triggers when safety_score crosses threshold.

Sam: API surface: GET /profiles/:id/safety returns {safety_score, last_eval_ts, recent_delta_pct, quarantined}. also POST /profiles/:id/override to allow per-customer opt-outs.

Lee: agree on per-customer override; also require a "quarantine_anchor" timestamp so profiles removed by auto-evict can't be reattached for X hours. prevents flip-flopping during a rollout.

Maria: tradeoffs: aggressive thresholds reduce risk but lose cost/time savings. we need per-endpoint cost-sensitivity. translation endpoints tolerate slightly lower latency but not quality drops. summarization is opposite. we should allow endpoint-level sensitivity weight overrides.

Nora: telemetry: emit metrics per profile id: profile_safety_score, profile_shadow_success_rate, profile_fallback_rate, profile_playback_delta. dashboards + alert rules: trigger paged alert if profile_fallback_rate > 2% in 1h for production tiers.

Devon: important: when multiple profiles are chained (cascade fallback), ensure we rate-limit fallback traffic so downstream pools don't get saturated. ops-bot: create ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-5678 created: "Profile safety_score, per-endpoint sensitivity, API + auto-fallback playbook". Assignee: Lee. Priority: P1.

Lee: I'll draft a short RFC: safety_score calc, API contract, quarantine semantics, and cascade throttling. will post later today.

Anya (QA): I'll prototype the playback job and run it against profile-zh-2026-03b; will post diff charts here.

Maria: temporary mitigation: roll profile-zh-2026-03b back to shadow-only for now, keep spike monitoring. thanks all. :thumbsup:
